# goslop text fixture — exception-type extraction embedded in the returned
# value: the failure state is surfaced but the broad catch still merges
# distinct failure conditions (WeThePeople jobs/warm_politician_cache.py:60
# TP shape)
lang: python
file: type_surfaced.py
---
def probe(person_id):
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        resp = fetch(person_id)
        return (person_id, time.time() - t0, resp)
    except Exception as exc:
        return (person_id, time.time() - t0, f"ERR:{type(exc).__name__}")
